source_edition: The Best Stories of Sarah Orne Jewett, Volume 2 (of 2), originally published in 1899 and printed in a Mayflower edition in 1925; selected and arranged with a preface by Willa Cather. Project Gutenberg identifies HathiTrust images as its transcription source. Earnalism serves only Jewett's A White Heron story, not Cather's preface, other collection contents, source boilerplate, Project Gutenberg marks, or illustrations.
source_edition_editor: Willa Cather (1873-1947), editor/selector of the 1925 collection; no claim is made that she authored the documented word-level variants.
source_edition_copyright_notices: Project Gutenberg's source transcription records Sarah Orne Jewett copyright dates 1886, 1888, 1890, 1893, 1895, and 1899, and Mary R. Jewett copyright dates 1914, 1916, 1918, 1921, and 1923. No separate preface, editorial text, or illustration is reproduced.
source_license: Project Gutenberg's public-domain notice is US-specific source provenance, not the basis of India clearance. India clearance rests on the applicable Indian term for the identified literary and source contributors; the 1925 volume's preface and other compilation matter are excluded.
text_comparison: The complete canonical story matches the identified 1925 Project Gutenberg eBook 74980 story body after whitespace and pagination folding only. The 1886 first-edition scan has documented variants at three readings; Earnalism follows the identified 1925 reading and has not changed the canonical text.
